claims.claim: 3. A session must belong to an Activity. Activity links to a category (nullable, ON DELETE SET_NULL) and nothing else. It has no tracker link. Tracker and Activity are separate tables, and TrackerEntity has no activityId.

claims.claim: 6. Manual entry and editing of a past session exist, and a session carries a nullable comment (the note).

7. Sync of SessionEntity: a single row-level stamp (updatedAtMillis + updatedByDevice), not per-field stamps. Deletion is a tombstone (deletedAtMillis). The GC hard-deletes tombstones after 90 days. Session is purged before activity.

missed.fact: SessionEntity has a ninth column, plannedRun String? (a RunStamp encoding for timed runs, separate from comment). It was added in migration 3 -> 4, and a merge must carry it.
updateSession clears deletedAt and only rewrites a row that is live at write time. A row that is missing or already tombstoned is skipped, so an edit cannot resurrect a deleted session.
stopSession does nothing if the session already has an end. Editing a running session to give it an end time also ends the run.

The purge query is a strict less-than on the cutoff (deletedAtMillis < :cutoffMillis). The domain predicate uses strict > on the Duration, yet RoomPurgeOrderingTest describes >= semantics. The boundary at exactly 90 days is inconsistent and should be checked.
The Activity tombstone also tombstones live goals whose targetId points at the activity. There is no FK on goals, so this is done by hand.

ActivityEntity has a single updatedAtMillis stamp for all metadata (name, color, icon, category, archived). archived is an extra state alongside deletedAtMillis. Archived activities are hidden from lists but not tombstoned.

Session time-window queries filter on startedAtMillis only (BETWEEN). A session that started before the window but overlaps it is not returned, so totalIn's clipping only applies to sessions that start inside the window.
